title: Training Language Model Agents to Find Vulnerabilities with CTF-Dojo
abstract: arXiv:2508.18370v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities when trained within executable runtime environments, notably excelling at software engineering tasks through verified feedback loops. Yet, scalable and generalizable execution-grounded environments remain scarce, limiting progress in training more capable ML agents. We introduce CTF-Dojo, the first large-scale executable runtime tailored for training LLMs with verifiable feedback, featuring 658 fully functional Capture-The-Flag (CTF)-style challenges containerized in Docker with guaranteed reproducibility. To enable rapid scaling without manual intervention, we develop CTF-Forge, an automated pipeline that transforms publicly available artifacts into ready-to-use execution environments in minutes, eliminating weeks of expert configuration traditionally required. We trained LLM-based agents on just 486 high-quality, execution-verified trajectories from CTF-D

translated_title: 使用 CTF-Dojo 训练语言模型智能体发现漏洞
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）在可执行运行时环境中训练时展现出了卓越的能力，尤其通过可验证的反馈循环在软件工程任务中表现突出。然而，可扩展且可泛化的基于执行的环境仍然稀缺，限制了训练更强机器学习智能体的进展。我们提出了 CTF-Dojo，这是首个专为训练具有可验证反馈的 LLM 而设计的大规模可执行运行时环境，包含 658 个功能完整的夺旗（CTF）式挑战，并以 Docker 容器化方式确保可重现性。为了在没有人工干预的情况下实现快速扩展，我们开发了 CTF-Forge，这是一个自动化流水线，能够在几分钟内将公开可用的工件转换为可直接使用的执行环境，省去了传统上需要数周专家配置的过程。我们仅使用来自 CTF-D（原文在此处截断）的 486 条高质量、经过执行验证的轨迹对基于 LLM 的智能体进行训练……
tldr: 提出了 CTF-Dojo——首个面向 LLM 训练的大规模可验证执行环境，包含 658 个容器化 CTF 挑战，并配套自动化流水线 CTF-Forge，可数分钟内将公开工件转化为即用型执行环境，仅需 486 条高质量轨迹即可训练出擅长漏洞发现的智能体。
en_tdlr: CTF-Dojo introduces the first large-scale executable runtime with 658 containerized, verifiably-reproducible CTF challenges, paired with CTF-Forge—an automated pipeline that converts public artifacts into ready-to-use environments in minutes—enabling LLM agents to be trained on just 486 high-quality execution-verified trajectories for vulnerability discovery.
